text: OI! Listen up! Companies are ditching job interviews for AI tests, and the candidates are using AI to ANSWER the AI! It's robots interviewing robots, mate!
action: leans aggressively into the mic, pointing both fingers at the camera like a debater

text: Fair dinkum, nobody's even in the room anymore! You could send your TOASTER to a job interview these days and it'd probably get the gig!
action: shadow boxes at an imaginary toaster while flexing his bicep

text: Yeah, nah. Sounds about right. Saves everyone the trouble of pretending to like each other for forty minutes.
action: slow blink, takes a lazy sip from his stubby holder without breaking eye contact

text: Speaking of robots doing the work — this episode is proudly UN-sponsored by 'BoomBot AI Resume Juicer', guaranteed to make your CV sound like you personally invented the wheel!
action: holds up a crumpled piece of paper like it's a product box, grinning wide at the lens

text: Wrap this up. That's not a sponsor, mate, that's just you lying to a printer.
action: chews gum leaf slowly, unimpressed stare directly into camera

text: But get this — the AI interview bots are getting TRICKED by other AIs! Candidates are literally feeding their laptop mic the answers in real time! ABSOLUTE STREWTH!
action: wipes imaginary sweat off his brow then slams both paws on the desk

text: So basically... it's two toasters lying to each other, and somewhere a human's still unemployed. Mad as a cut snake, this whole system.
action: leans back in chair, arms crossed, giving Boomer a slow sideways glance

text: So the real winner of the job market... is whoever's got the better Wi-Fi connection! GAME CHANGER, Kev!
action: throws both arms up in triumphant realization then freezes mid-fist-pump
